model: normalized beta pulse constrained to reported aggregate Cmin/Cavg/Cmax; not mechanistic PK

spray.limitation: Geometric means for three separate metrics do not form an observed person; constructed pulse is only mathematically consistent with their numeric aggregate values.

xyosted.group: 137 hypogonadal men at week12, titrated doses 50/75/100mg pooled
xyosted.limitation: median individual Tmax not guaranteed Tmax of group mean; these are arithmetic mean summary indices; cannot use to model actual missed doses or initial injections

patch.limitation: does not predict endogenous T baseline

nasal.limitation: decay-only scenario, not fitted nasal concentration

limitations: UK Lenzetto not verified French product listing
Product specific; no transfer to other spray or gel
No prospective time series, only synthetic steady period; summary-matched is not dose-response validated
